title: Quality Control Method Statement
description: Free Quality Control Method Statement template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers 1.0 inspection equipment, 2.0 sampling plan, 3.0 inspection characteristics.

4.0 Acceptance Criteria

CRITICAL CHARACTERISTICS (Safety/Regulatory):

• All critical characteristics must meet specification 100%

• Zero defects allowed

MAJOR CHARACTERISTICS (Function/Performance):

• Must meet specification limits

• AQL = 1.0% maximum

MINOR CHARACTERISTICS (Appearance/Finish):

• Within specification limits

• AQL = 4.0% maximum
